archetype: High-Contrast AI SaaS & Tactical Cambodian Omnichannel Commerce
theme_strategy: Dual-Theme (Light & Dark Mode supported via HSL CSS Variables with explicit toggle)

brand_identity.tagline_khmer: ឆ្លើយតបសារអតិថិជនស្វ័យប្រវត្តិ ២៤/៧ ជាមួយ AI
brand_identity.tagline_english: Omnichannel AI Auto-Reply System for Cambodian Businesses

rules: Headings (H1/H2) must use Outfit with tight letter spacing tracking-tight.
Khmer script text must render smoothly with Noto Sans Khmer and proper line-height leading-relaxed.
Never use Inter for Main or Sub-headings.
Header H1 ceiling is text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl max.
Use bold typography contrast for numbers and KHQR price tags.

landing_page.nav: Sticky glassmorphic navbar with logo icon + text 'Replyflow AI', links (Features, Demo, Pricing, Notion KB), Khmer/English switcher, Theme toggle (Sun/Moon), and 'Sign In / Get Started' CTA button.
landing_page.hero: Asymmetric hero with headline 'Every client message, answered in seconds.', Khmer subhead, twin primary buttons ('Start Free Trial', 'Watch Telegram Demo'), and interactive Live Telegram phone mockup displaying Khmer voice-to-voice & product suggestion replies.
landing_page.features_grid: Mode A Bento Grid (12 cols desktop): Hero box for Telegram & FB Messenger omnichannel, VoxCPM2 Khmer Voice Cloning card, Notion KB sync card, Bakong KHQR 1-tap payment card, AI product suggestion with photos card.
landing_page.how_it_works: 3-step interactive flow: 1. Connect Channel -> 2. Sync Product Catalog & Notion -> 3. Auto-reply & Collect KHQR Payments.
landing_page.footer: Dark rich contrast footer with company links, Khmer language badge, and large brand mark.

auth_pages.split_layout: Left column marketing highlight box (Blue-Indigo gradient backdrop with VoxCPM2 voice note visualizer, Bakong KHQR preview, 3 key selling points), right column auth card with Email/Password + Google Login button.
auth_pages.theme_toggle_location: Top right corner of the auth container.

dashboard_shell.desktop_sidebar: 260px left sidebar with Replyflow AI logo, business switcher dropdown, nav items (Inbox, Products, Orders, AI Settings, Channels, Businesses), Theme toggle, current business status badge, user avatar.
dashboard_shell.mobile_bar: Fixed top header with logo + business selector + Theme toggle, bottom 390px mobile icon navbar for quick switching between Inbox, Products, Orders, AI Settings.
dashboard_shell.header_controls: Includes Business Selector dropdown, AI master toggle (Active / Paused), Light/Dark theme toggle button, and user profile menu.

inbox_page.structure: 3-pane layout (Responsive: 1-pane on 390px mobile with drawer/tab navigation, 3-pane on 1920px desktop).
inbox_page.left_pane: Conversation list with channel filters (All, Telegram, Messenger), search input, unread badges, customer avatar, time ago, AI active pill.
inbox_page.center_pane: Active Chat Thread with channel banner, customer info, customer/AI/agent speech bubbles, Khmer voice note audio player waveform, AI product recommendation cards with photo + price + 'Send to Chat' button, Bakong KHQR payment request card.
inbox_page.right_pane: Customer AI Summary Panel: Buying Intent score, AI Stage (Inquiry -> Product Selection -> Payment Pending -> Completed), Next Suggested Action, Quick Reply Chips (Khmer & English), Human Takeover toggle.

products_page.layout: Header with 'Add Product' button, search bar, category tabs. Grid of product cards with rich photo preview, Khmer name, price in USD/KHR, stock status, and actions (Edit, Delete, Recommend in AI).

orders_page.layout: Analytics header (Total Revenue, Paid via Bakong, Pending KHQR), Table with order ID, Customer, Channel, Items, Total Price, Status pills (Paid - Emerald, Pending - Amber, Expired - Slate), KHQR invoice modal preview.

sections: Business Profile (Shop Name, Description, Greeting Message in Khmer)
Notion Knowledge Base Integration (Notion API Key, Database Selector, Sync Now status)
Bakong KHQR Payment Settings (Bakong Account ID, Merchant Name, Auto-generate KHQR toggle)
Khmer Voice Cloning (VoxCPM2 engine toggle, Seller Voice Clone recorder/uploader with audio wave preview, voice pitch & speed controls)
AI Behavior & Auto-reply Rules (Tone: Friendly/Professional, Auto-suggest products threshold, Hand-over to human rules)
Quick Reply Templates & Team Notification emails

cards: Telegram Bot Integration (Token input, Webhook status, Test Bot Connection button, Connected indicator)
Facebook Messenger Integration (Page Access Token, App Secret, Connect Page button, Active Webhook badge)

admin_businesses_page.layout: Table listing 100+ Cambodian shop tenants, active bot status, monthly order count, channels connected, plan subscription, action buttons.

components_and_styles.buttons: Pill or rounded-lg buttons with vibrant primary gradient (`bg-gradient-to-r from-blue-600 to-indigo-600 hover:from-blue-700 hover:to-indigo-700 text-white shadow-md transition-all`). Secondary buttons: `border border-border bg-card hover:bg-muted text-foreground`.

general_ui_ux_guidelines: All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, filters, tabs, menu items, toggles, cards, actions) MUST include a kebab-case data-testid attribute.
Support both Light and Dark mode seamlessly via HSL CSS variables configured in index.css.
Ensure 100% responsiveness from 390px mobile screens to 1920px desktop viewports.
Khmer text should use 'Noto Sans Khmer' for clean readable typography across headers and body.
Theme toggle button must be present in Landing navbar, Auth page headers, and Dashboard top header/sidebar.
Keep existing functionality intact while drastically improving layout, spacing, visual polish, and component design.
